Key.English: Path Planning
Enable Path Planning
Enables the path planning mode: drag a path in front of a selected unit or vehicle and it drives, flies, sails or walks it. Off by default.
Trail the Rest of the Selection

While tracing one path, give every other selected unit of the same kind the same path ending a fixed distance further back, so a column is one gesture instead of six. Only paths nothing has been drawn on are recruited, and grabbing a handle takes that path back under manual control.
Hold Units While Planning

Stop the selected units in place for as long as a path is being drawn for them, so they do not walk out from under it. Released when planning ends. Note that a unit already being held still by something else — a LAMBS garrison, for example — is released along with the rest.
Aircraft: hold Alt while dragging to set altitude, Shift for coarse steps.
Hold Ctrl and click a point on a path to cut it back to there.
Delete clears the path under the cursor. Escape cancels without ordering anything.
Vehicles: hold Shift while dragging to pull the path onto the nearest road.
Infantry: hold Shift as you grab an arrow to turn it instead of drawing.
Infantry: hold Alt while drawing to advance facing the way the arrow points.
Drag the arrow in front of a unit to trace the path it should take.
How Infantry Walk a Path
Own navigation

Whether a man is carried along his drawn path by animation, or navigates it himself. Carrying him is the only way a drawn line gets walked as drawn — his own navigation rounds the corners, re-forms with his group, and arrives somewhere near the line rather than on it — but while he is being carried his AI movement is off, so he cannot take cover or path around an obstacle he was walked into. He will still break off to engage what shoots at him or walks into his arc, and he will still open doors in front of him.
Carried for the whole path
Own navigation, carried in marked stretches
Patrol Loop
Maximum Path Speed

Fastest a vehicle will drive a planned path, in km/h. Capped well below most vehicles' top speed on purpose: a vehicle given its full config speed drives a traced path like a time trial and loses the line on the first corner. A group set to Limited speed halves this again.
Path planning cancelled
Executing paths
Nothing in the selection can be given a path
Planning paths
Tint the Screen While Planning
Desaturate the view for as long as a path planning session is open, so the mode is unmistakable. Affects only your own screen and nothing about how paths are drawn or executed.
Fly and Sail Paths Exactly

Move aircraft and boats along their drawn path directly, setting attitude and speed each tick, so a traced flight plan is flown as traced. The engine cannot drive aircraft or boats along a path at all, so the alternative is a chain of move orders that gives the AI a destination but no line — a traced valley run comes out as a straight leg over the ridge, at whatever height and speed the AI prefers. Turn this off to keep real physics, collision and autorotation, at the price of a flight plan followed approximately. Helicopters still land themselves when a path is drawn onto the ground.
Path Timeout

Time in minutes a unit may spend following a planned path before the path is abandoned. A backstop, not the usual way a path ends — it exists so a unit whose destination became unreachable is not still walking towards it hours later.
Toggle Path Planning

Opens path planning for the selected units and vehicles: drag the arrow in front of one to trace the path it should take. Press again to execute every path drawn, or Escape to cancel. Selecting a crew member plans for the vehicle he is riding in.
